response.sql: WITH appearances_with_bats AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) as hand_count FROM appearances a INNER JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), stats AS (SELECT SUM(hand_count) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_hands, SUM(hand_count) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_count FROM appearances_with_bats) SELECT awb.bats, awb.hand_count as count, awb.hand_count * 1.0 / s.total_count as share, awb.hand_count * 1.0 / s.avg_count as count_div_avg FROM appearances_with_bats awb CROSS JOIN stats s
